description: Show the user something in the Convexity app by its address — the same token mentions use: a component on the map or in the grid ("[[component:generator/Tuas CCGT]]", "[[component:load/City|in=table]]"), a value in the grid or a series at a moment ("[[value:load/City|attr=p_set|at=2030-01-01T05:00]]"), a scenario ("[[scenario:High gas]]"), a dashboard ("[[dashboard:Results/Costs]]"), a deck ("[[deck:Q3 Review]]"), or several at once ("[[show:table|type=generator|names=A;B|cols=p_nom]]", "[[show:map|names=A;B]]"). Use it whenever the user should SEE what you are talking about.

address.description: The address token, with or without the surrounding [[ ]].

name: show_address
